messages:
sophia: posting AB run for v3.0-int4 vs baseline v3.0-fp16 (quiet burn). overall latency P95 -22%, cost lower, but some quality deltas on code-completion slices.

mike: numbers? quick summary please (mrr / accuracy / hallucination rate).

sophia: MRR_code: control 0.842 -> variant 0.831 (-1.3%). hallucination_rate_code up 0.6pp. long-doc summarization unchanged. token KL divergence increased on code tokens ~0.014.

ada: hmm, KL bump could explain token-level shift. what's sample count per slice? small n can spike KL.

sophia: code slice n=3.2k, seqlen>1k n=480, so code is well-sampled.

lukas: propose gate change: composite_score = weighted_sum([mrr_delta_norm, kl_norm, hallu_delta_norm]) with weights [0.5,0.3,0.2]; thresholds: soft>=0.4 (pause ramp + human inspect), hard>=0.7 (autofallback).

nina: add hysteresis: require two consecutive windows (15m windows) breaching threshold before hard action. reduces flapping.

ada: and min_sample per-slice = 500 to qualify for composite. also cap single-slice influence to 30% of composite via clipping.

mike: operationally need: cooldown after autofallback 45m, auto-report to accuracy-oncall with attached diff samples.

sophia: here's the canary payload i'm about to push:

```json
{
  "variant":"v3.0-int4",
  "stages":[{"pct":1,"dur":"30m"},{"pct":5,"dur":"1h"}],
  "metric_windows":["15m","60m"],
  "composite_gate":{
    "weights":{"mrr":0.5,"kl":0.3,"hallu":0.2},
    "soft":0.4,
    "hard":0.7,
    "min_sample":500,
    "slice_cap":0.3,
    "consecutive_windows":2,
    "cooldown":"45m"
  }
}
```

deploy-bot: canary-config push accepted by canary-controller v1.15. Audit: /ops/deploys/1743225005.
orion-bot: quiet-burn started: shadow 8% traffic, eval cadence 15m. Monitoring: mrr_code, kl_token_code, hallucination_rate.

lukas: console ask: can we show the top-5 contributing slices for composite and include exemplar diffs inline? ops triage is much faster that way.

ada: yes, will add exemplar diff link and expose slice contributors via /console/rollouts/<id>/contributors. also will flag repeated soft holds -> auto-assign to accuracy team after 2 soft holds within 6h.

mike: one more: add a rollback-safe tag so infra can pin variant on dedicated pools to avoid partial capacity mixing during fallback.

sophia: done. i'll monitor first 2 hours and share the 15m heatmaps here. if we hit hard gate, follow runbook: autofallback->incident doc->sample dump.

nina: thanks, watching. :eyes:
